attributes.board_name: Arizona Department of Health Services – Bureau of Licensing, Hearing and Speech Professionals

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses directly related to SLP, above introductory level, covering advances within the last 5 years (practice, auditory rehabilitation, ethics, federal/state statutes or rules, etc.). Courses developed, endorsed or sponsored by ASHA, ArSHA, AAA, ADA (audiology), AAS, IHS, IIHIS, Hearing Healthcare Providers of Arizona, otolaryngology societies, or equivalent organizations qualify.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application includes an attestation that CE was completed and documentation is available upon request.
rules.notes: Regular license is valid 2 years; CE must be completed in the 24 months before the renewal application. 30-day grace period with late fee; after that a new license application with 20 hours of CE from the previous 24 months is required.
rules.rule_quote: D. When renewing a regular license in audiology or in speech-language pathology, the licensee shall provide proof of having completed at least twenty hours of continuing education within the prior twenty-four months.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses directly related to audiology (and hearing aid dispensing for audiologists who fit and dispense), above introductory level, covering advances within the last 5 years. Max 8 hours per 24 months from courses sponsored by a single hearing aid manufacturer.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application includes an attestation that CE was completed and documentation is available upon request.
rules.notes: Audiologists who fit and dispense hearing aids must make the 20 hours relate to audiology and hearing aid dispensing. Regular license valid 2 years; 30-day grace period with late fee.
rules.rule_quote: D. When renewing a regular license in audiology or in speech-language pathology, the licensee shall provide proof of having completed at least twenty hours of continuing education within the prior twenty-four months.
